title: Restarting in Public - 3 AI Projects in 30 Days
content:
For the next thirty days, I am going to build three AI projects, and I will show you every step.
The code, the architecture, the bugs, and the parts that do NOT work yet.
So why am I doing this in public?
Because watching AI news is easy. Anyone can repeat a headline.
But companies do not hire people who repeat headlines. They hire people who can SHIP working systems.
And clients do not pay for opinions. They pay for problems that get solved.
So instead of only talking about AI, I want to show you what I can build with it.
Project ONE is an AI knowledge assistant.
You give it your documents, and it answers questions from them, with the source for every answer.
This technique is called RAG, retrieval augmented generation.
I picked it first because almost every company has the same problem. The answers exist, but they are buried in PDFs, docs and old emails.
And here is the hard part nobody shows you.
Making a demo is easy. Making it answer correctly, and say "I don't know" when it should, is the real work.
So I will test it, measure it, and share where it fails.
Project TWO is a lead qualification agent.
Imagine a small business gets fifty enquiries a week.
The agent reads each one, asks the right follow up questions, scores the lead, and passes only the serious ones to a human.
This is where AI turns into revenue, and that is the language business owners understand.
Project THREE is a support copilot.
It sorts support tickets and suggests replies, but a human approves every reply before it goes out.
Because the goal is not to replace the team. It is to give them back hours every week.
For each project, I will share a short demo, the architecture, and an honest list of limitations.
If something breaks, you will see that too.
Here's my take. In AI, proof beats promises.
Thirty days from now, I would rather show you three working systems than three hundred posts about other people's work.
If you are on a similar path, build alongside me, and tell me which project you want to see first.
Follow for your daily AI update.
